name: com.xiqima.meshtextbaker
description: Bake localized TMP text/images onto mesh albedo/PBR maps. Optional Unity/I2/custom provider adapters, mod-friendly external overrides and baseline export for books and props. Requires TextMeshPro incl. TMP Essential Resources; works with Built-in, URP and HDRP. Example scenes included: flippable book + feature showcase (Package Manager > Samples).
